name: METFORMIN / VILDAGLIPTINE 850/50MG 30 TABLETS NOVARTIS
description: It is indicated for the treatment of type 2 diabetes when glucose levels are not adequately controlled with metformin alone or in combination with other medications. The combination of its two active ingredients helps improve glycemic control in the following ways: Vildagliptin: It works by stimulating the pancreas to produce more insulin and less glucagon after meals. Metformin: It helps the body use insulin better and reduces glucose production by the liver. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
